dct_title_s: King County, Washington : trolley line footprints
dct_description_sm: Abstract: King County, Washington trolley line footprints. Streets with overhead trolley wire derived from the King County Street Network datalayer (The source coverage is current as of 11/29/94). Trolley lines are contained within the City of Seattle.

Purpose: This data set is a reference for location of overhead trolley wire to help in planning construction projects or moving overheight vehicles on city roads. Providing trolley wire locations helps in expansion and maintenance of existing facilities. Identify the location of facilities which reduces chances of damage during construction.
